subject: a round dimmer knob turned partway
sourceSummary: Plan and document a progressive feature-flag rollout for shipping a change behind a flag — defining the flag and its default-off state, the staged ramp (internal → 1% → 10% → 50% → 100%) with the success and guardrail metrics that gate each step, the automatic rollback/kill-switch criteria, and the cleanup that removes the flag once fully rolled out.
